text:
anna: scheduling a small DR/drill next Thurs 09:30 UTC to test break-glass HSM access and BYOK procedures. want to validate RBAC changes, audit logging, and emergency key release paths. who can make it?

jonah: i can join but heads-up i'll be oncall rotations that day. prefer we do it earlier in the window (09:00-10:30).

kevin: i'll prep a short runbook patch to ensure audit events are written to the immutable store + Splunk index before the drill. need to verify syslog forwarding and event schema.

miriam: ✳️ compliance checklist: we need a paper trail for who invoked break-glass, justification, and signed approval. SOC2 and PCI both require proof of least privilege and approval for privileged key access.

elena: confirm vendor HSM behavior (Luna/Thales). does our HSM accept a one-time emergency unseal token or do we require a split-key quorum? affects RBAC flow.

anna: good q. our current test HSM supports a split-escrow unseal (3-of-5). for the drill let's exercise both a) RBAC role escalation via admin console and b) unseal via quorum. plan: stage a dummy customer CMK imported into test HSM.

kevin: logging notes — ensure the KMS connector emits these fields: event_type, actor, auth_method, key_id, action, correlation_id. example: {"event_type":"kms.key_unseal","actor":"anna","auth_method":"hsm-quorum","key_id":"test-cmk-2026","action":"unseal","correlation_id":"drill-204850"}

miriam: we can't store any PII in logs. redact certificate fingerprints. retention for drill artifacts: 1 year in compliance bucket, mark as audit:drill.

jonah: opsbot, can you link the incident runbook and create a temp RBAC change request ticket?

opsbot: Incident Runbook: https://redwood.example/playbooks/hsm-breakglass. Temporary RBAC ticket created: RBAC-DRILL-204850 (expires 24h after closure).

elena: small ask — when we create the temporary role, ensure it has explicit deny on production customer key exports and only allow test-cmk-2026. we should also add a forced MFA requirement on elevation.

anna: noted. sample temp policy (apply in test tenant):
```
{
  "Version": "2024-10-01",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Unseal","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":["arn:redwood:kms:eu:test:test-cmk-2026"]},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["kms:ExportKeyMaterial","kms:DeleteKey"],"Resource":["arn:redwood:kms:::*"]}
  ]
}
```

kevin: i'll run the policy in staging and post results. also will wire the Splunk query: `index=redwood_kms drill correlation_id=drill-204850 | sort _time`

miriam: for the compliance packet, include: timeline, approvers (signed), audit log export (redacted), screenshots, and post-drill RCA. I'll draft the approval template.

jonah: vuln triage note: if any HSM firmware vulnerability appears during the drill, pause immediately and escalate to eng-sre and security. we should simulate that pause path too.

anna: good call. we'll include an abort test: person X triggers firmware-check-fail state and we walk the rollback/containment steps. assign roles:
- runbook owner: anna
- audit export: kevin
- compliance packet: miriam
- vendor liaison: elena
- oncall exec: jonah

kevin: ack. i'll also snapshot KMS connector logs before the drill and mark the snapshot ID in the ticket.

opsbot: Reminder scheduled: Drill prep meeting Tue 09:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent to participants.

anna: final ask — everyone add brief step-level checklists to RBAC-DRILL-204850 by EOD Monday. we'll treat this as a lightweight incident test, not a real customer-key operation. :thumbsup:

jonah: 👍

miriam: :ok_hand:

elena: on it.
